title: Mouthrinse active matrix metalloproteinase-8 in periodontitis prevention
html: Xie and colleagues1 evaluated testing by self-administered mouthrinse active matrix metalloproteinase-8 (aMMP-8), questionnaire-based screening models, and professionally administered quantitative aMMP-8 models for periodontitis screening in a Chinese population. Periodontitis causes major societal and economic burdens and often progresses with limited patient awareness.1,2 Clinical confirmation often occurs only after substantial tissue destruction has become clinically detectable.1,2 This creates a need for preventive strategies and simple screening tools that prompt earlier periodontal assessment.
